title: Amount Due at the Start of Work on a Ridgeline Installation Services Contract
content:
**Clause.** On a Ridgeline Installation Services contract, the start-of-work payment is the program's progress payment percentage of the contract price billed, rounded to the cent, plus the uncovered fees, which are every fee charged on the contract less every payment made on it for fees, rounded to the cent. The sum is rounded to the cent.

## Terms used

- **The program's progress payment percentage** is the progress payment figure of the installation program on the contract, in the program table of payment terms.
- **The contract price billed** is the contract price on the contract billing line made at signing.
- **The progress share** is that percentage of the contract price billed, rounded to the cent.
- **Every fee charged on the contract** is the total of the contract's fee lines: reschedule fees, trip charges, cancellation fees, permit fees, permit handling fees, haul-away fees and change order administration fees.
- **Every payment made on it for fees** is the total of the contract's payment lines whose purpose is fees; deposits and other payments do not count here.

## Worked examples (hypothetical contracts)

| Progress payment percentage | Contract price billed | Progress share | Fees charged | Fee payments | Uncovered fees | Start-of-work payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 25 | 12000.00 | 3000.00 | 225.00 | 75.00 | 150.00 | 3150.00 |
| 33 | 9000.00 | 2970.00 | 95.00 | 0.00 | 95.00 | 3065.00 |
| 33 | 10500.00 | 3465.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3465.00 |

## Basis questions answered

**Are deposits deducted from the start-of-work payment?** No. The payment is the progress share plus the uncovered fees; a deposit is not a payment made for fees.
